annotations.title: Competitive Hiring Report for one job posting

description: Competitive Hiring Report, free summary, for the employer of one US healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing job posting (nurses, therapists, pharmacists, accountants, bankers, software engineers, data roles, engineers, scientists, attorneys, recruiters, marketers) that is not filling: the posted pay range in that market (salary benchmarking) and how many employers are hiring it. The full report, first one free (request_full_report), names each competitor with the pay it posts and how fast it closes the role (posting up to posting down), and shows where this posting sits and how hard the role is to fill there. Measured from employers' own careers sites. Identify the posting by job_url (the careers-site link, or a veritahire.com/j/ link), job_id, or employer + title (+ city, state). A role not yet benchmarked returns status "building" with retry_after_seconds, the time until it is ready.

job_url.description: The posting's URL on the employer's careers site, or a veritahire.com/j/ URL
